chunks.src: Los leones son los felinos que más socializan y su vida transcurre dentro de grupos de gran tamaño denominados manadas. En medio del cálido clima del Oriente Medio, la caza no era de mayor importancia.
chunks.out: Lions are the most social felines, and their lives take place within large groups called prides. In the midst of the warm climate of the Middle East, hunting was not of great importance.

chunks.src: Las playas son casi todas de arena con lugares seguros para nadar y en su mayoría tienen árboles poutukawa que ofrecen lugares de sombra.
chunks.out: Almost all the beaches are sandy with safe places to swim, and most of them have poutukawa trees that provide shade.

chunks.out: Prides are formed by 1 to 3 adult males from the same family group, joined with up to 30 females and their cubs. It is possible that feral children suffered traumatic situations or severe child abuse before being abandoned or fleeing. In Skoturb, bus 403 is

chunks.src: dirige con regularidad a Sintra y para en Cabo da Roca. La forma de disfrutar las mejores vistas de Hong Kong es salir de la isla y dirigirse a la ribera de Kowloon, ubicada enfrente. Los pensamientos de Aristóteles, en especial las cuestiones de la ciencia e incluso la psicología, fueron aceptadas.
chunks.out: runs regularly to Sintra and stops at Cabo da Roca. The best way to enjoy the best views of Hong Kong is to leave the island and head to the Kowloon waterfront, located opposite. Aristotle's thoughts, especially the questions of science and even psychology, were accepted.

chunks.src: Mitchell Gurley, de Australia, obtuvo el undécimo puesto en la categoría masculina de pie del slalom supergigante. El competidor checo Oldrik Helinek terminó decimosexto en el grupo masculino de sentados.
chunks.out: Mitchell Gurley from Australia took eleventh place in the men's standing super-G slalom. Czech competitor Oldrik Helinek finished sixteenth in the men's sitting group.

Likewise, after the Revolution, the positions were open to all male candidates, which allowed for the success of the most ambitious and prestigious. The atomic bomb operates based on the

chunks.out: principle that energy is required to form a nucleus with a large number of protons and neutrons.

chunks.src: No mencionó una cifra para los recortes y manifestó que se harán en base a la producción económica de China. No hay un criterio universal que determine cuándo un bien manufacturado puede ser considerado una antigüedad. Algunas agencias impositivas tienen establecido que los objetos de más de 100 años son antigüedades.
chunks.out: He did not mention a figure for the cuts and stated that they will be made based on China's economic production. There is no universal criterion that determines when a manufactured good can be considered an antique. Some tax agencies have established that objects over 100 years old are antiques.

chunks.src: No siempre se precisa un yate en los archipiélagos y lagos. Por ello se dice que la relación dimensional de este formato, dividir por 12 a fin de calcular la razón de números enteros más sencilla, equivale a 3.2.
chunks.out: A yacht is not always necessary in archipelagos and lakes. That is why it is said that the dimensional relationship of this format—dividing by 12 in order to calculate the simplest integer ratio—is equivalent to 3.2.
